Name: Convenient Crafting from Sheds
Author: arjan3004
Description:
Convenient Crafting from Sheds expands the workbench to connect to additional chests inside a building. Place it next to a building to pull items from the chests inside. Works well with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url] to connect to additional chests not directly adjacent to the workbench. 

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45590/45590-1777458531-704335170.png[/img]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Inventory [/url]No conflicts[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url] - Chests inside the shed are included for the [i]Add Items To Storage[/i] feature.[/*]
[*]Mods that modify the crafting menu will most likely not work.[/*]
[*]Looking to extend your fridge space a bit? Try [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2545]Remote Fridge Storage[/url][/*]
[/list]
